__prompts__.dataplatform_version: Framework Git ref the modules should be pinned to (e.g. v1.4.0)
__prompts__.aws_account_id: AWS account ID (12 digits) — used in resource ARNs
__prompts__.project_name: Project name — prefix for every AWS resource (lowercase, snake_case, e.g. 'name_of_your_company')
__prompts__.domain_name: Data domain name — one self-contained business unit (consisting of S3, Glue DB, IAM). Lowercase, snake_case, e.g. 'sales'
__prompts__.git_repository: Git repo URL of this domain — tagged on every AWS resource for traceability (can be empty)
__prompts__.pipeline_name: Pipeline name — Step Functions state machine suffix (e.g. 'main', 'tests')
__prompts__.failure_notification_receivers: Comma-separated emails for pipeline failure alerts (can be empty)
__prompts__.datalake_admin_principal_arns: Comma-separated IAM role names to grant Lake Formation admin on the domain (resolved via aws_iam_role data source (must exist); can be empty)
__prompts__.terraform_backend_bucket_name: S3 bucket holding Terraform state (must already exist). Leave empty to use a local backend (state stored under iac/terraform.tfstate.d/).
__prompts__.skip_emr_serverless_sandbox_creation: Skip building the EMR Serverless sandbox image (slow). 'true' if you don't run Spark tasks
